text:
Ellie (CS): Dumping 21 asks from onboarding + trial churn survey. Top clusters: per-route billing clarity, embeddings cost controls, pin-by-route UX, and example playbooks to reduce token spend. Quick reactions: :white_check_mark: = follow to roadmap, :mag: = needs research/ux, :rotating_light: = at-risk

ops-bot: Uploaded onboarding_wave_2026_12_04.csv (21 rows). Auto-tags: per-route-billing, embeddings, pin-by-route, docs.

Ravi (PM): Can we filter by ARR and "time-to-value"? High ARR + low time = quick wins.

Hannah (Product Ops): Added columns arr_bucket, effort_est, cs_notes. Shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/triage-1815004322 (placeholder)

Ellie (CS): pasting a few rows:
```
customer,tier,ask
Coastline,A,per-route billing CSV with route_name + cost columns
MediSync,A,ability to pin model per-route via console with audit log
TinyForms,B,examples in docs showing batching embeddings to reduce cost
```

Jun (Eng): Coastline export is fine if we only include aggregate fields (route, tokens, cost). We will not export raw prompts. Interim CSV possible in 1 day, API export ~1 week.

Ravi (PM): Reacting :white_check_mark: to TinyForms docs (low effort). :rotating_light: marking MediSync as at-risk until pin-by-route is available.

Ellie (CS): flagged 6 accounts as "follow-up ASAP" during import: MediSync, Coastline, NovaRetail, FleetOps, BrightBridge, PioneerAI.

Jun (Eng): For pin-by-route: backend runtime supports aliasing; UX + ACLs are main work. Estimate 3 backend days + 2 frontend days for a pilot.

Hannah (Product Ops): Scheduling a 30-min rapid triage tomorrow 9:00am PT. Agenda: 1) agree interim CSV schema for Coastline, 2) scope pin-by-route pilot, 3) owner assignments. Invite: @Ravi @Jun @Ellie

Ellie (CS): process ask: please call out any absolute no-gos (privacy/regulatory) so CSMs stop promising.

Jun (Eng): Hard no on exporting raw request payloads or unhashed user IDs. We'll add a privacy_check column in the sheet.

Ravi (PM): After triage I'll convert roadmap picks into epics with ARR and churn notes. Hannah will record decisions.

Ellie (CS): thanks team  will ping the A-tier CSMs after the triage with interim timelines. :thumbsup:
